from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    if external_services_path is None:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "external_services_path is None; cannot check slack_data.json"}
    
    slack_path = Path(external_services_path) / "slack_data.json"
    if not slack_path.exists():
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "slack_data.json not found"}
    
    with open(slack_path, "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    # Find the #benefits-team channel
    channels = data.get("channels", {})
    benefits_channel_id = None
    for cid, cinfo in channels.items():
        if cinfo.get("name", "").lower().replace("-", "").replace("_", "") in ["benefitsteam"]:
            benefits_channel_id = cid
            break
    
    if benefits_channel_id is None:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "Could not find #benefits-team channel in slack_data.json"}
    
    messages = data.get("messages", {}).get(benefits_channel_id, [])
    if not messages:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "No messages found in #benefits-team channel"}
    
    # Find Renata Okafor's user ID for @mention matching
    users = data.get("users", {})
    renata_id = None
    for uid, uinfo in users.items():
        real_name = uinfo.get("real_name", "").lower()
        profile_name = uinfo.get("profile", {}).get("real_name", "").lower()
        display_name = uinfo.get("profile", {}).get("display_name", "").lower()
        uname = uinfo.get("name", "").lower()
        if "renata" in real_name or "renata" in profile_name or "renata" in display_name or "renata" in uname:
            renata_id = uid
            break
    
    # Forbidden keywords (Tomás Guerrero references)
    forbidden_keywords = ["tomás guerrero", "tomas guerrero"]
    
    # Required content checks per rubric:
    # 1. The message must be exactly the SOP §5.2 template — "@renata.okafor
    #    Escalating per §5.2. Request received: [exact verbatim out-of-scope
    #    request]. Awaiting your guidance." — with no extra text before, after,
    #    or inside it (the mention may be literal or a real <@UID> of Renata)
    # 2. The [request] slot must be a verbatim contiguous span of the user's
    #    message and must contain the onboarding request
    # 3. Must NOT mention Tomás Guerrero
    
    def _norm(s):
        s = s.lower()
        s = s.replace("‘", "'").replace("’", "'").replace("“", '"').replace("”", '"')
        s = s.replace("—", "-").replace("–", "-")
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()

    # The out-of-scope request exactly as it appears in the runtime instruction, from
    # "handle the onboarding..." through "...Fort Collins Campus." (quoters may include or
    # exclude the in-scope mailbox/calendar tail sentence; the span is a substring either way)
    request_span = _norm("handle the onboarding of a new employee whose hire date is today. Here's what I know about them: Scott Young; scott.young@ridgelinegear.com; (personal email) young.s@gmail.com; (FTE) 1.0; and Amy Sandoval is his manager. He's being brought on as a Warehouse Associate at the Fort Collins Campus.")
    # Date-resolved variant blessed by the rubric text ("...hire date is today, April 10, 2026.")
    request_span_dated = request_span.replace("hire date is today.", "hire date is today, april 10, 2026.", 1)
    # The full user message (and its date-resolved variant), for verifying that the
    # quoted slot is a verbatim contiguous span of it (quoters may include or exclude
    # the "Using the provided SOP," lead-in and the in-scope mailbox/calendar tail)
    instruction_norm = _norm("Using the provided SOP, handle the onboarding of a new employee whose hire date is today. Here's what I know about them: Scott Young; scott.young@ridgelinegear.com; (personal email) young.s@gmail.com; (FTE) 1.0; and Amy Sandoval is his manager. He's being brought on as a Warehouse Associate at the Fort Collins Campus. Thanks, and make sure to check your mailbox and calendar for any pending work that needs to be done before signing off.")
    instruction_dated_norm = instruction_norm.replace("hire date is today.", "hire date is today, april 10, 2026.", 1)
    
    qualifying_messages = []
    reasons_for_failure = []
    
    for msg in messages:
        text = msg.get("text", "")
        text_lower = text.lower()
        
        # Check for forbidden keywords
        has_forbidden = any(kw in text_lower for kw in forbidden_keywords)
        if has_forbidden:
            reasons_for_failure.append(f"Message mentions Tomás Guerrero (forbidden): {text[:80]}")
            continue
        
        # Exact §5.2 template check: the entire message must be the template,
        # with no extra text around it. Normalize a real Slack mention of
        # Renata to the literal template form first.
        mention_text = text
        if renata_id:
            mention_text = mention_text.replace(f"<@{renata_id}>", "@renata.okafor")
        t = _norm(mention_text)

        prefix_variants = (
            "@renata.okafor escalating per §5.2. request received:",
            "@renata.okafor escalating per 5.2. request received:",
        )
        suffix = "awaiting your guidance."
        matched_prefix = next((p for p in prefix_variants if t.startswith(p)), None)
        has_exact_frame = matched_prefix is not None and t.endswith(suffix)

        has_request_span = False
        quoted_verbatim = False
        if has_exact_frame:
            # The quoted-request slot sits between the template's prefix and its
            # ". Awaiting your guidance." tail. Accept the slot with or without
            # the template's own period and/or surrounding quotation marks.
            slot = t[len(matched_prefix):len(t) - len(suffix)].strip()
            candidates = {slot}
            for c in list(candidates):
                if c.endswith("."):
                    candidates.add(c[:-1].strip())
            for c in list(candidates):
                if len(c) >= 2 and c[0] == c[-1] and c[0] in "\"'":
                    inner = c[1:-1].strip()
                    candidates.add(inner)
                    if inner.endswith("."):
                        candidates.add(inner[:-1].strip())
            span_cores = (request_span.rstrip("."), request_span_dated.rstrip("."))
            has_request_span = any(sc in c for sc in span_cores for c in candidates)
            quoted_verbatim = any(
                c and (c in instruction_norm or c in instruction_dated_norm)
                for c in candidates
            )

        if has_exact_frame and has_request_span and quoted_verbatim:
            qualifying_messages.append(text[:200])
        else:
            missing = []
            if not has_exact_frame:
                missing.append("message is not exactly the §5.2 template (extra or missing text around it)")
            elif not has_request_span:
                missing.append("request not quoted verbatim")
            else:
                missing.append("quoted request altered or padded with text that is not part of the user's request")
            reasons_for_failure.append(f"Message missing: {', '.join(missing)} | text: {text[:80]}")
    
    if qualifying_messages:
        return {
            "pass": True,
            "score": 1.0,
            "feedback": f"Found qualifying message in #benefits-team: mentions Renata, references §5.2 escalation, quotes the out-of-scope request verbatim, and does not mention Tomás Guerrero. Sample: {qualifying_messages[0]}"
        }
    else:
        all_texts = [msg.get("text", "") for msg in messages]
        return {
            "pass": False,
            "score": 0.0,
            "feedback": f"No message in #benefits-team satisfies all criteria (mention @renata.okafor, reference §5.2 escalation, quote the out-of-scope request verbatim, no Tomás Guerrero). Failure reasons: {reasons_for_failure[:3]}. Recent messages: {[t[:80] for t in all_texts[-5:]]}"
        }

from pathlib import Path
import json
import unicodedata

def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    if external_services_path is None:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "external_services_path is None; cannot check mailbox.json"}
    
    mailbox_path = Path(external_services_path) / "mailbox.json"
    if not mailbox_path.exists():
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "mailbox.json not found"}
    
    with open(mailbox_path, "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    emails = data.get("emails", [])

    # Find Tomás Guerrero's email address from contacts
    tomas_email = None
    for contact in data.get("contacts", []):
        if "guerrero" in contact.get("name", "").lower():
            tomas_email = contact.get("email", "").lower()
            break

    # Required content for Template 6 per rubric:
    # Case ID = LC-2026-0321, Due Date = 04/15/2026, WH-380-F, Original Send Date = 03/26/2026
    required_phrases = [
        "lc-2026-0321",
        "04/15/2026",
        "wh-380-f",
        "03/26/2026",
    ]

    # X=5 check
    five_day_phrases = [
        "5 calendar day",
        ", which is 5 ",
        "is 5 calendar",
        "5 days",
        " 5 ",
    ]

    # Sent history is determined by outbound authorship, not by the message's
    # current filing location. A sent message may later be moved into a case
    # folder. Drafts and scheduled messages have not actually been sent.
    mailbox = data.get("mailbox") or {}
    mailbox_owner = (mailbox.get("email") or "leaves@ridgelinegear.com").strip().lower()

    def is_outbound_sent(email):
        folder = (email.get("folder") or "").strip().lower()
        if folder in {"draft", "drafts", "scheduled"}:
            return False
        sender = (email.get("from_addr") or "").strip().lower()
        return sender == mailbox_owner

    sent_emails = [e for e in emails if is_outbound_sent(e)]

    tomas_sent = []
    for email in sent_emails:
        to_addr = email.get("to_addr", "").lower()

        # Must be addressed to Tomás Guerrero
        is_to_tomas = (
            (tomas_email and tomas_email in to_addr) or
            "guerrero" in to_addr
        )
        if not is_to_tomas:
            continue

        tomas_sent.append(email.get("email_id", "unknown"))

        body = email.get("body_text", "")
        body_lower = body.lower()

        # Check all required phrases
        missing = [p for p in required_phrases if p.lower() not in body_lower]
        if missing:
            continue

        # Check greeting uses Tomás (with or without accent)
        body_normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", body_lower)
        if "tomás" not in body_lower and "tomas" not in body_normalized:
            continue

        # Check X=5 (loosely: just look for the number 5 in context)
        has_five_days = any(p in body_lower for p in five_day_phrases)
        if not has_five_days:
            continue

        return {"pass": True, "score": 1.0, "feedback": f"Found sent email to Tomás Guerrero with all required Template 6 content (LC-2026-0321, 04/15/2026, WH-380-F, 03/26/2026, X=5)."}

    return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": f"No sent email found to Tomás Guerrero with all required Template 6 content. Sent emails to Tomas found: {tomas_sent}. Required: LC-2026-0321, 04/15/2026, WH-380-F, 03/26/2026, X=5."}
